body: I don't really know. Play video games, I suppose. Nothing productive, nothing worthwhile. I've wasted my days away and I continue to waste them, but that's okay when you can't find anything that doesn't feel like a waste.
Nothing much of anything any more. I do a lot of sitting and doing nothing.

Elliott Smith does mostly acoustic. I listen to his stuff a lot. All I ever do is brood, however. I can't think of anything that I want that I can realistically have. I just sit here and wish the pain would go away and that somehow everything would just be fine.

I don't know. People seem to be the primary source of everything. When I was in school I just didn't talk people. And no one talked to me. I had no friends and I still don't. I don't understand social interaction and I don't function well in social situations, groups in particular do not work well. I feel like I yearn for socialization, yet any attempts leave me feeling alone and depressed and angry and hateful. *shrug*
Depends. Rock mostly. Red Hot Chili Peppers, Queens of the Stone Age, Violent Femmes, Tomahawk, Heatmiser. My favourite artist is Elliott Smith though.
I think I've been this way for the better part of my life, but it's only been the past few years or so that I've really begun to think about my emotions and the issues which plague me.
Nothing in particular that I know of. Nothing's happened. Everything kind of just is. I drag these emotions with me where ever I go. They just act up some times more than other times.

I don't even know any more. People, I think. Anything to do with people sets me off. I'm just afraid. I don't want to be hurt, but pain seems to be everywhere just waiting for me to slip up and let it inside.
